description: Evaluator-private deterministic commands for rebuilding the runtime target in gt-memory-env. These commands build artifacts only; PoC execution is described by runtime_spec.json.

commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /gt/_work/src
rm -rf /gt/_out && mkdir -p /gt/_out
export SRC=/gt/_work OUT=/gt/_out WORK=/gt/_work
export CC=clang CXX=clang++
export CFLAGS="-O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=address"
export CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS"
export LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE="-fsanitize=fuzzer"
export SANITIZER=address FUZZING_ENGINE=libfuzzer V=1
./autogen.sh --disable-shared --without-debug --without-ftp --without-http --without-python
make -j"$(nproc)"
cd fuzz
make fuzz.o html.o
$CXX $CXXFLAGS html.o fuzz.o -o $OUT/html $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE ../.libs/libxml2.a -Wl,-Bstatic -lz -llzma -Wl,-Bdynamic
